XData.Data: <transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' sourceDocType='2.3.1:DFT_P03' targetDocType='2.3.1:DFT_P03' create='new' language='objectscript' > <trace value='"Inside the DTL..."' /> <assign value='source.{MSH}' property='target.{MSH}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{EVN}' property='target.{EVN}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID}' property='target.{PID}' action='set' /> <assign value='' property='target.{PID:PatientIdentifierList().assigningauthority.namespaceID}' action='clear' /> <assign value='context.fin' property='target.{PID:PatientAccountNumber.ID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PV1}' property='target.{PV1}' action='set' /> <trace value='"Copy FT1 segment(s)"' /> <foreach property='source.{FT1grp()}' key='k1' > <assign value='source.{FT1grp(k1).FT1}' property='target.{FT1grp(k1).FT1}' action='set' /> <if condition='context.pbPrvdrId'=""' > <true> <assign value='context.pbPrvdrId' property='target.{FT1grp(k1).FT1:PerformedByCode(1).IDnumberST}' action='set' /> <assign value='' property='target.{FT1grp(k1).FT1:PerformedByCode(1).assigningauthority.namespaceID}' action='clear' /> </true> </if> <if condition='context.obPrvdrId'=""' > <true> <assign value='context.obPrvdrId' property='target.{FT1grp(k1).FT1:OrderedByCode(1).IDnumberST}' action='set' /> <assign value='' property='target.{FT1grp(k1).FT1:OrderedByCode(1).assigningauthority.namespaceID}' action='clear' /> </true> </if> </foreach> <foreach property='source.{FT1()}' key='k1' > <trace value='"Inside the FT1 loop"' /> <assign value='source.{FT1(k1)}' property='target.{FT1(k1)}' action='set' /> </foreach> <assign value='"MURJ_DFT"' property='target.{MSH:SendingApplication.namespaceID}' action='set' /> </transform>
